policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: For every A, point at the current visible center of the same cube identified by target_anchor, allowing small shifts after placement; use the release trajectory in the current interval to disambiguate nearby cubes. policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: For every A, select the current table cube consistent with the unchanged target_anchor and any table-height grasp/release location visible in the current execution interval, allowing small placement shifts. When these cues agree, transient lifted-object labels or airborne centroids referring to a different cube must not override them. Use release motion to resolve ambiguity only when it is consistent with these cues; never transfer target identity solely because another cube is reported as lifted. Point at the selected cube's current visible table center, not the raised wrist or an airborne centroid. The point must select that same object; it need not reproduce an earlier grasp coordinate exactly.
